Q2i.question: Every remaining field and nonsplit determinant
Q2i.finding_ids_or_current_gate: Every split class-number-one sixfold, every Eisenstein determinant and Gaussian signed determinant class3 has a numerical detector bound. Other nonsplit determinants remain open. Curve sources require actual original-field descent and period rank9. Original reflection-free coefficient degree>=15; inducing dimensions1/2/3 and non-Eisenstein7 are excluded. The remaining inducing4/5/6/8 exceptional profiles are exactly D-BI11/12,D-R5,D-BI16,HD-E8IF1; the explicit paired G33 Nielsen component is excluded, other components/descent remain. D-BI13/14/14a/15 impose the stated ramification, degree and nonnormality bounds. For every primitive factorwise tensor-indecomposable inducing degree>=5, D-BI19 forces an irreducible transitive quasisimple central-product core. D-BI18/20 excludes extraspecial cores and Lie fieldsq>=29 in degree>=10, with stronger ESD bounds. All sporadic, all A1, all Suzuki/Ree/Tits, all transitive linear-Weil SL_n(q) (n>=3), and all G2(q>=3)/3D4(q>=2) cores are excluded (D-SPOR,D-BI21/22/23,D-G2T01--03); the last result permits mixed factors. Odd symplectic Weil cores reduce to singleSp4(3)degree4/5; D-SPW04 gives the same nonsplit non-Eisenstein endpoint for all its representations. D-BI24 reduces all transitive ordinary unitary-Weil cores to single PSU4(2) degree5/6, with only5 in the stated nonsplit scope. D-ESC01--03 excludes all even-characteristic Sp4/Sp6 cores in the main problem, allowing mixed ranks/fields for q>=4 and using BI17 only for the transitive Sp6(2) degree7 endpoint. D-A2-01--03 excludes all ordinary quasisimple PSL3(q)/PSU3(q) cores q>=3, including mixed types/fields; L34-1--3 proves the exceptional36-class normalizer coverage. PSL3(2)=PSL2(7) remains explicitly outside. D-HES-F excludes all mixed products of Sp8(2),Sp10(2),Sp12(2), including scalars/permutations. Other small-field higher-rank Lie cores remain. All spin2.An,n>=8, and all ordinaryAn,8<=n<=14, are excluded (HD-SPIN02,HD-ALT02,D-AST). HD-ALT03 forces all remaining ordinary An,n>=15 factors to extend to real Specht modules, so the inducing image is ESD. HD-ALT04/05 further force every transitive factor label to have a row/column>6n/7; the final tail-content bound gives e<=144 against unsplit factor degree>=250 in the excluded annulus. The all-degree scalar single-factor standard,exterior-square andunordered-pair cases remain excluded; long-shape tensor cases and residualA7/covers remain. These are necessary supplier restrictions, not existence results. The non-curve alternative is Q5i.
